title: Tide
short: Water. Strong against Ember.
lines: Hits Ember bosses for 50% more damage.
Hits Spark bosses for 25% less damage.
Tide hits leave Soaked on the boss. Spark cashes it in.

title: Ember
short: Fire. Strong against Grove.
lines: Hits Grove bosses for 50% more damage.
Hits Tide bosses for 25% less damage.
Ember hits leave Scorched on the boss. Tide cashes it in.

title: Grove
short: Plants. Strong against Spark.
lines: Hits Spark bosses for 50% more damage.
Hits Ember bosses for 25% less damage.
Grove hits leave Overgrown on the boss. Ember cashes it in.

title: Spark
short: Lightning. Strong against Tide.
lines: Hits Tide bosses for 50% more damage.
Hits Grove bosses for 25% less damage.
Spark hits leave Charged on the boss. Grove cashes it in.

title: Setter
short: Marks the boss for a combo.
lines: Its hit leaves its element's mark on the boss.
It can swap a mark of another element.
Other roles only mark a boss that has no mark.
Act before the creature that cashes the mark in.

title: Payoff
short: Hits reactions harder.
lines: A Payoff that sets off a reaction deals 10% more.
Any role can set off a reaction. Payoffs do it best.
Put it after a Setter that leaves the right mark.

title: Guard
short: Tough. Takes hits for its zone.
lines: Has 30% more HP than other roles.
A boss hit aimed at one creature goes to a Guard in the same zone.
Hits on a whole zone still reach everyone in it.
Best at the front, where the boss attacks first.

title: Support
short: Powers up its neighbours.
lines: Each round it boosts the creatures right next to it.
Their next hit deals 15% more damage.
A knocked-out or silenced Support gives no boost.
Place it between your strongest hitters.

title: Soaked
short: Tide's mark. Spark cashes it in.
lines: Left on the boss by a Tide hit.
A Spark hit sets off Overload.
Only a Setter of another element can swap it.
It stays until it is cashed in or swapped.

title: Charged
short: Spark's mark. Grove cashes it in.
lines: Left on the boss by a Spark hit.
A Grove hit sets off Grounding.
Only a Setter of another element can swap it.
It stays until it is cashed in or swapped.

title: Overgrown
short: Grove's mark. Ember cashes it in.
lines: Left on the boss by a Grove hit.
A Ember hit sets off Wildfire.
Only a Setter of another element can swap it.
It stays until it is cashed in or swapped.

title: Scorched
short: Ember's mark. Tide cashes it in.
lines: Left on the boss by a Ember hit.
A Tide hit sets off Steam.
Only a Setter of another element can swap it.
It stays until it is cashed in or swapped.

title: Overload
short: Spark on Soaked: 4.5 times damage.
lines: A Spark hit on a Soaked boss sets it off.
It deals 4.5 times the normal damage.
It uses up the mark. The next hit leaves a new one.
Any role can set it off. Payoffs deal 10% more.

title: Grounding
short: Grove on Charged: 4.5 times damage.
lines: A Grove hit on a Charged boss sets it off.
It deals 4.5 times the normal damage.
It uses up the mark. The next hit leaves a new one.
Any role can set it off. Payoffs deal 10% more.

title: Wildfire
short: Ember on Overgrown: 4.5 times damage.
lines: A Ember hit on a Overgrown boss sets it off.
It deals 4.5 times the normal damage.
It uses up the mark. The next hit leaves a new one.
Any role can set it off. Payoffs deal 10% more.

title: Steam
short: Tide on Scorched: 4.5 times damage.
lines: A Tide hit on a Scorched boss sets it off.
It deals 4.5 times the normal damage.
It uses up the mark. The next hit leaves a new one.
Any role can set it off. Payoffs deal 10% more.

title: Zone attack
short: Hits every creature in one zone.
lines: Every living creature in that zone takes a hit.
A Guard cannot take it for the others.
A Shield Wall on that zone softens it.
The stage warns you one round ahead.

title: Silence
short: The row's ends skip a turn.
lines: The creatures at both ends of the row skip their next turn.
A silenced Support gives no boost.
Keep your best hitters away from the ends.
The stage warns you one round ahead.

title: Reflect
short: Turns a reaction back on you.
lines: The first reaction of the round hurts your creature, not the boss.
The boss only takes the normal hit. The mark is still used up.
Later reactions in the same round work as usual.

title: Strongest strike
short: Targets your top attacker.
lines: Hits the living creature with the highest Attack.
A Guard in its zone takes the hit instead.
A Shield Wall on that zone softens it.

title: Front
short: Closest to the boss. Hit first.
lines: The row is split into a front, a middle and a back part.
The boss's normal attack hits the front first.
When the front is knocked out, it moves on to the middle.
Guards belong here.

title: Middle
short: The rest of the row.
lines: Front and back get a third of the row each.
The middle gets whatever is left.
A row of 1 or 2 creatures is all middle.
The boss hits it once the front is down.

title: Back
short: Farthest from the boss. Hit last.
lines: The boss's normal attack reaches it last.
Zone attacks and tricks can still reach it.
Automatic placement puts Payoffs here.

title: Left to right
short: The row acts from slot 1 on.
lines: Creatures act in slot order, slot 1 first.
Put Setters before the creature that cashes in.
To repeat a reaction, alternate a Setter and a cashing creature.

title: Right to left
short: The row acts from the last slot.
lines: Creatures act in reverse slot order, the last slot first.
Put Setters before the creature that cashes in.
To repeat a reaction, alternate a Setter and a cashing creature.

title: By Speed
short: Fastest creature acts first.
lines: Creatures act from highest Speed (SPD) to lowest.
With equal Speed, the lower slot goes first.
Check each creature's SPD on the Creatures tab.

title: Auto fire
short: Fires abilities for you.
lines: On: an ability fires by itself in its round.
Tap Fire to use one sooner. It lands next round.
Off: it waits for you, and still fires in the last round.

title: Creature ability
short: A move for the live finale.
lines: Every species has its own ability.
It unlocks at level 10 and gets stronger when the creature evolves.
Up to 3 team creatures fire one each, plus your basic ability.
Each ability fires once.

title: Basic ability
short: Everyone brings one.
lines: Pick Rally, Shield Wall, Re-mark or Purge before the finale.
It is weaker than a creature ability.
If you do not pick, one is chosen for you.

title: Rally
short: Rally: everyone hits harder for a while.
lines: Every creature's hits deal bonus damage.
It lasts for the number of rounds the ability says.
It adds up with Support boosts and other Rallies.

title: Shield Wall
short: Shield Wall: one zone takes less damage.
lines: Cuts the damage one zone takes, for the rounds the ability says.
Two walls on one zone stack.
Creature abilities shield their own creature's zone.
The stage warns you one round before a zone attack.

title: Re-mark
short: Re-mark: puts a mark on the boss.
lines: It replaces any mark the boss has.
Basic Re-mark lets you pick the element.
Creature abilities use their own element.
Then the right element can cash it in.

title: Purge
short: Purge: turns off the boss's counter-move.
lines: It switches the Phase 2 counter-move off for a few rounds.
It only matters once the boss has a counter-move.
When it ends, the boss adapts again.

title: Strike
short: Strike: hits the boss right away.
lines: The creature hits the boss at once for a share of its Attack.
It can cash in a mark like any other hit.
It still lands if the creature has been knocked out.

title: Boss Rank
short: How tough this week's boss is.
lines: Each Rank adds 40% more boss HP. Its Attack grows too.
Win a normal week's finale and the Rank goes up by 1.
Lose and the Rank stays the same.
Higher Ranks pay more Essence.

title: Festival
short: Every 5th week: easier and richer.
lines: Every 5th raid week is a Festival.
The boss fights 3 Ranks lower, and Essence pays 50% more.
Win the finale to win the Festival creature.
A win keeps the Rank. After a Festival, the Rank eases by 1.

title: Season
short: 5 raid weeks, ending in a Festival.
lines: A season is 5 raid weeks.
Weeks 1 to 4 are normal. Week 5 is the Festival.
The pips show where you are. The last pip is the Festival.
Then a new season begins.

title: Readiness
short: How ready your team looks.
lines: A rough guess of how the finale could go.
It comes from a forecast. It is not a promise.
The words are Long shot, Even, Likely and Strong.

title: Long shot
short: Your team looks short for this boss.
lines: Train your creatures and set a better row to improve it.
A long shot can still win: combos and crits swing fights.

title: Even
short: Could go either way.
lines: Your team looks about as ready as this boss is tough.
Combos and crits can tip it.

title: Likely
short: Your team looks ready.
lines: A win looks likely for this boss.
It is not a promise: crits and boss tricks can surprise you.

title: Strong
short: Your team looks very ready.
lines: A win looks very likely for this boss.
It is still a forecast, not a promise.

title: Counter-move
short: The boss adapts after Phase 1.
lines: After Phase 1 the boss adapts to what worked best.
Reaction Resistance: your most used reaction does 50% less bonus damage.
Element Resistance: your top damage element does 25% less.
A Purge ability switches it off for a few rounds.

title: Essence
short: Raid reward. Evolves creatures.
lines: Every raid stage you clear pays Essence.
Most of it is the same for all. The rest depends on how much you helped.
Higher Ranks and Festival weeks pay more.
Evolving costs 20 Essence (40 for rare creatures).

title: Bait
short: Currency from leets in Discord.
lines: Your leets in Discord turn into Bait.
Spend it to train creatures and fund expeditions.
Extra copies of a fully fused creature turn into Bait.

title: Training cost
short: Bait to train: 3 + 2 x level.
lines: Going up one level costs 3 + 2 x its level, in Bait.
Level 1 to 2 costs 5 Bait. Level 10 to 11 costs 23.
Half price if the creature is more than 5 levels below the server's median.
A creature away on an expedition cannot train.

title: Level
short: Higher level, stronger creature.
lines: Train a creature with Bait to raise its level.
Each level adds HP, Attack and Speed.
A creature that can evolve stops at level 15 until it does. The top is 30.
At level 10 a creature gets its finale ability.

title: Critical hit
short: A lucky hit that does extra.
lines: Every hit has a 5% chance to be critical.
A critical hit does 50% more damage.
A few creatures crit more often, or harder.
The boss can crit too, with the same odds.

title: Fusion
short: Duplicates make a creature stronger.
lines: A duplicate catch fuses into the creature you already have.
Each fusion adds stats, up to 20% after 5 fusions.
The stars show your fusions. After 5, a duplicate gives Bait.

title: Rarity
short: How hard a creature is to find.
lines: Common, Rare or Epic.
Rarer creatures turn up less often on expeditions.
Better supplies improve the odds.

title: Shiny
short: A rare sparkly colour.
lines: About 1 in 500 catches is shiny.
A shiny duplicate makes your creature shiny.
It is only for show. A shiny has the same stats.

title: Away
short: On an expedition.
lines: It cannot be trained until it is back.
Claim or recall the expedition to bring it home.

title: First on server
short: Nobody here had it before you.
lines: You were the first on this server to get it.
Everyone who got it at the same moment shares the title.

title: Gear
short: One item per creature, worn into every fight.
lines: Gear adds to Attack, HP, speed and crits. What it adds in total is capped.
Upgrade an item from +0 to +5 with Essence and scrap. Upgrades never fail.
Dismantle an item to get parts back. This cannot be undone.

title: Workshop
short: Your creatures work on jobs here, even while you are away.
lines: You can run 2 jobs at once, and each job needs a creature.
A creature on a job cannot go on an expedition, and the other way round.
It still fights in raids.

title: Blueprint
short: Teaches you to craft one kind of item. Learned once.
lines: Blueprints come from expeditions (more often on long ones) and the welcome kit.
A blueprint you already know turns into 5 scrap.

title: Attack bonus
short: Adds a percentage to a creature's Attack.
lines: Gear adds at most 20% Attack to one creature, however many bonuses it has.

title: HP bonus
short: Adds a percentage to a creature's HP.
lines: Gear adds at most 25% HP to one creature, however many bonuses it has.

title: Speed bonus
short: Adds a percentage to a creature's speed.
lines: Speed decides who acts first against a boss that goes by speed.
Gear adds at most 10% speed to one creature.

title: Crit chance bonus
short: Adds points to the chance of a critical hit.
lines: A creature starts at 5%, and the game caps any creature at 30%.
Gear adds at most 5 points.

title: Crit damage bonus
short: Adds points to the extra damage of a critical hit.
lines: A critical hit adds 50% damage to start with, and the game caps it at 150%.
Gear adds at most 25 points.

title: Common gear
short: A main stat and nothing else.
lines: Common gear is easy to find and cheap to upgrade.

title: Rare gear
short: A stronger main stat and one extra stat.
lines: Its main stat roll is 25% higher than Common.
Rare gear costs more to upgrade and can be improved.

title: Epic gear
short: A much stronger main stat and two extra stats.
lines: Its main stat roll is 50% higher than Common.
Dismantling Epic gear can give glimmer.

title: Festival gear
short: Epic power with a look of its own.
lines: Won by clearing a Festival finale, and crafted only from Festival blueprints.
It has no extra power over Epic gear.

title: Scrap
short: Generic parts. They pay for upgrades, crafting and improving.
lines: Found by dismantling gear, on expeditions, in cleared raid phases and in the daily dungeon.

title: Tide Shard
short: A shard of Tide. It pays for Tide crafts and enchants.
lines: Found on expeditions with a Tide explorer, from Tide room bosses and by dismantling Tide gear.

title: Ember Shard
short: A shard of Ember. It pays for Ember crafts and enchants.
lines: Found on expeditions with an Ember explorer, from Ember room bosses and by dismantling Ember gear.

title: Grove Shard
short: A shard of Grove. It pays for Grove crafts and enchants.
lines: Found on expeditions with a Grove explorer, from Grove room bosses and by dismantling Grove gear.

title: Spark Shard
short: A shard of Spark. It pays for Spark crafts and enchants.
lines: Found on expeditions with a Spark explorer, from Spark room bosses and by dismantling Spark gear.

title: Glimmer
short: A rare part. It pays for Epic crafts and every enchant.
lines: Found by dismantling Epic gear, at dungeon landmarks, and rarely on expeditions (more often on long ones).

title: Payoff's Edge
short: +6% Attack for a Payoff.
lines: Only works for a Payoff.
Costs 1 glimmer and 3 Ember shards.
An item has one enchant slot: a new enchant replaces the old one.

title: Guard's Bulwark
short: +8% HP for a Guard.
lines: Only works for a Guard.
Costs 1 glimmer and 3 Grove shards.
An item has one enchant slot: a new enchant replaces the old one.

title: Setter's Wit
short: +5% speed for a Setter.
lines: Only works for a Setter.
Costs 1 glimmer and 3 Tide shards.
An item has one enchant slot: a new enchant replaces the old one.

title: Support's Grace
short: +6% HP for a Support.
lines: Only works for a Support.
Costs 1 glimmer and 3 Spark shards.
An item has one enchant slot: a new enchant replaces the old one.

title: Spark Luck
short: +3 points crit chance for Spark creatures.
lines: Only works for Spark creatures.
Costs 1 glimmer and 3 Spark shards.
An item has one enchant slot: a new enchant replaces the old one.

title: Ember Fury
short: +10 points crit damage for Ember creatures.
lines: Only works for Ember creatures.
Costs 1 glimmer and 3 Ember shards.
An item has one enchant slot: a new enchant replaces the old one.

title: Tide Flow
short: +4% speed for Tide creatures.
lines: Only works for Tide creatures.
Costs 1 glimmer and 3 Tide shards.
An item has one enchant slot: a new enchant replaces the old one.

title: Grove Hide
short: +7% HP for Grove creatures.
lines: Only works for Grove creatures.
Costs 1 glimmer and 3 Grove shards.
An item has one enchant slot: a new enchant replaces the old one.

title: Steady Hand
short: +3% Attack.
lines: Works for every creature.
Costs 1 glimmer and 3 Tide shards.
An item has one enchant slot: a new enchant replaces the old one.

title: Craft
short: Makes a new item from a blueprint you know.
lines: Takes 4 hours for Common, 8 for Rare and 12 for Epic or Festival.
The parts are paid when the job starts. The item is rolled when you claim it.

title: Improve
short: Re-rolls one extra stat of an item, for scrap.
lines: Takes 2 hours. Needs a Rare or better item.
The new stat can be better or worse. Claim it to see.

title: Enchant
short: Adds an enchant to an item.
lines: Takes 6 hours. Costs glimmer and shards.
A new enchant replaces the old one.

title: Crafting skill
short: Grows slowly each time a creature finishes a job.
lines: Each level above 1 makes jobs 3% shorter and adds 1% chance of a better craft.
It levels slowly: about level 5 after a month of steady work.
It never changes how a creature fights.

title: Daily dungeon
short: One run a day with a team of three of your own.
lines: Pick three creatures and where they stand, then enter. The whole run is played out at once.
Three rooms: two foes, then a room boss. Each creature keeps its HP from room to room.
Clear all three to go one depth deeper. A lost run keeps your depth.
One run per day, resetting at midnight in the server's time zone. A lost first run can be retried once.

title: Dungeon depth
short: How deep you are. Foes get tougher with every depth.
lines: Clearing all rooms adds 1. Losing leaves it as it is.
Each depth adds about 30% foe HP and 20% foe Attack, and a little more the deeper you go.
It is yours alone: nobody else's runs change it.
Every 7th depth is a landmark.

title: Room modifiers
short: Each room has a twist, shown before you enter.
lines: The day's three modifiers are the same for everyone on the server.
Some boost one element, some change the foe, and some change who acts first.
They only last for their room. Pick your team around them.

title: Room boss
short: The foe of the last room. Tougher than the others.
lines: It has more HP and hits harder than the foes before it.
Each boss has its own trick, and some are the same ones raid bosses use.
Beating it clears the dungeon for the day.

title: Landmark
short: Every 7th depth. A full clear drops gear for sure.
lines: Landmark depths are 7, 14, 21 and so on.
Clear all rooms on one to get a gear drop for certain, with better odds of rare and epic gear.
It also pays extra Essence, scrap and a glimmer.

title: Daily streak
short: Days in a row with a dungeon run.
lines: Your streak grows by 1 each day you run the dungeon.
The 3rd and 7th day of every 7 pay a bonus.
Miss a day and the count starts again. Your depth stays.

title: Flooded
short: Tide creatures hit 20% harder.
lines: Works for every Tide creature on your team, in this room only.
Plan your team around it: it is shown before you enter.

title: Scorched
short: Ember creatures hit 20% harder.
lines: Works for every Ember creature on your team, in this room only.
Plan your team around it: it is shown before you enter.

title: Overgrown
short: Grove creatures hit 20% harder.
lines: Works for every Grove creature on your team, in this room only.
Plan your team around it: it is shown before you enter.

title: Stormy
short: Spark creatures hit 20% harder.
lines: Works for every Spark creature on your team, in this room only.
Plan your team around it: it is shown before you enter.

title: Dark
short: Your creatures crit 5 points more often.
lines: Only for the room that has it, and shown before you enter.
Plan your team and where they stand around it.

title: Thorns
short: The foe turns the first reaction of each round back on your team.
lines: Only for the room that has it, and shown before you enter.
Plan your team and where they stand around it.

title: Brittle
short: The foe has 20% less HP but hits 25% harder.
lines: Only for the room that has it, and shown before you enter.
Plan your team and where they stand around it.

title: Fog
short: Nobody can see: everyone acts in slot order, left to right.
lines: Only for the room that has it, and shown before you enter.
Plan your team and where they stand around it.
